'''Mike Tortorelli''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Nevada State Championship]] on 15 April 2001 with RST scouts, according to Dan Christy's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2086">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-desert-showdown-nv-statesd2086/ desert-showdown-nv-states], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 16 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-desert-showdown-nv-statesd2086/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
